question: What proportional parts are prescribed for four-hand and five-hand measures?
premises: A three-and-a-half part is associated with it.
A quarter part is associated with a five-hand measure.
inference: For four hands the part is three-and-a-half, and for five hands it is a quarter.
uncertainties: The exact architectural element to which these parts apply is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: For a four-hand measure there is a three-and-a-half part, and for a five-hand measure a quarter part.
